# RunPod templates

Both the MiniMax H3 FL2VA and Ref2VA models have two different RunPod templates:

- **Plus tail:** provisions the H3 generation tail required by this workflow.
- **Plus QWEN prompt enhancer:** provisions the separate QWEN prompt enhancer. If you want to use this tail-based workflow on that template, follow the manual tail download instructions below.

## FL2VA

- [Deploy MiniMax H3 FL2VA plus tail](https://console.runpod.io/deploy?template=v7b5g03csk&ref=se4tkc5o)
- [Deploy MiniMax H3 FL2VA plus prompt enhancer](https://console.runpod.io/hub/template/a1nkufhzxq?ref=se4tkc5o)

## Ref2VA

- [Deploy MiniMax H3 Ref2VA plus tail](https://console.runpod.io/deploy?template=6qtfx7lxgc&ref=se4tkc5o)
- [Deploy MiniMax H3 Ref2VA plus prompt enhancer](https://console.runpod.io/hub/template/pcsqepl6kt?ref=se4tkc5o)

# Manual H3 generation-tail download

This prompt-generator workflow uses `H3QwenVLGenerationTailLoader` and requires:

`qwen3vl_32b_h3_generation_tail_50_63_int8_convrot.safetensors`

Download it from Hugging Face to the directory specified by the provisioning documentation:

```bash
mkdir -p /workspace/ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/H3

hf download ethanfel/Qwen3-VL-32B-Ultra-Heretic-MiniMax-H3-ComfyUI-INT8-ConvRot \
  qwen3vl_32b_h3_generation_tail_50_63_int8_convrot.safetensors \
  --local-dir /workspace/ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/H3
```

Restart ComfyUI or refresh the loader after the download.

## Provisioning documentation inside the pod

1. Start the pod and wait until code-server is ready.
2. In RunPod, select **Connect** and open the HTTP service on port **9000**, or use `https://<POD_ID>-9000.proxy.runpod.net`.
3. Sign in with the pod's `PASSWORD` environment variable.
4. Open `/workspace/README.md` in the code-server Explorer.
5. Open `/workspace/docs/provisioning/hf_MiniMax-H3.md` and see **Optional uncensored INT8 ConvRot text encoder** for the complete provisioning command.
